Interface HookDemand

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@Internal @FunctionalInterface public interface HookDemand
Callback through which the runtime asks the instrumentation layer to weave the hooks for a set of operations before a scenario that needs them starts.

Hooks are woven on demand: a JVM with the agent attached but no scenario for, say, ThreadLocal or clock reads carries no advice in those JDK methods. require(Set) is called synchronously during activation, so a scenario takes effect as soon as activate() returns; implementations must be idempotent and thread-safe.

    • methods

      default void methods(Set<ChaosSelector.MethodSelector> selectors)
      Weaves method entry and exit hooks into exactly the methods selectors name, removing them from methods no selector names any more. Called with the method selectors of every registered scenario: before a scenario with a ChaosSelector.MethodSelector is registered, and after a scenario is removed. Implementations must be idempotent: a call with the set already woven does nothing.
      Parameters:
      selectors - the method selectors to weave; empty to remove every method hook
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the hooks cannot be woven; the activation fails
